integrity: Exact count and coefficient identities are proved analytically; exhaustive finite enumeration is supporting verification only. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
limitations: Uniform unweighted spanning forests of K_{3,n} only; no inference about weighted Rayleigh property, general edge events, or arbitrary bipartite graphs. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature confirmation.
title: Exact strict edge anticorrelation for uniform forests of \(K_{3,n}\)
